ai.title: Biocon Academy introduces three new programmes
ai.description: Biocon Academy, a Centre of Excellence for Advanced Learning in Applied Biosciences, hosted its 10th graduation ceremony at its Bengaluru campus, with 156 students graduating this year. Seven top-performing students were awarded gold medals for academic excellence. Three new programmes, including Artificial Intelligence in Life Sciences, Drug Metabolism, and Pharmacokinetics, were also introduced.
